title: fix: correct polli audio filenames and playback failure
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Refs #15443: derives the default audio filename from `--format`.
- Fixes #15439 by bounding the Windows MediaPlayer startup wait and returning a nonzero exit code when playback fails.
- Adds tests for all documented output formats; CLI package suite passed (190 tests).
- Windows playback runtime verification remains outstanding; PowerShell is unavailable on this Mac.
- Quest accounting: only #15440 and #15439 are PR-closing reports in this batch; the other reports are linked and closed manually.

gist.headline: The bee found the file
gist.blurb: Polli CLI now gives generated audio the right filename for its chosen format, and Windows playback no longer waits around forever when the player declines the invitation.
gist.summary: Fixed Polli CLI audio generation so default output filenames derive from the selected --format, and bounded Windows MediaPlayer startup while returning a nonzero exit code on playback failure.
gist.impact: CLI users can reliably find audio files with extensions matching every documented output format, while failed Windows playback now finishes promptly and reports failure to scripts and terminals.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful audio technician in a cozy garden workstation, labeling a row of tiny audio-file jars with matching format tags while a friendly retro Windows-style media player monitor successfully plays a warm waveform. Use code-plants and flowers to make the filename-and-playback fix feel like putting each sound seed in the correct pot.
